// Remaster status bar, composed from UTNT artwork.
// Clip the original top so the lower STARMS frame can move down seven pixels.
// This adds space for weapon slot 8 without stretching the border or its palette.

{
    Patch "STARMS", 0, 0
}

// Reduced-view surround uses a power-of-two flat for the engine's border tiler.
// Mirrored 16-pixel STBAR crops meet seamlessly and preserve palette indices.
// Keep GRNROCK unchanged because maps can also use it as a world texture.

{
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 0, 0
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 16, 0 { FlipX }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 32, 0
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 48, 0 { FlipX }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 0, 16 { FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 16, 16 { FlipX FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 32, 16 { FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 48, 16 { FlipX FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 0, 32
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 16, 32 { FlipX }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 32, 32
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 48, 32 { FlipX }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 0, 48 { FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 16, 48 { FlipX FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 32, 48 { FlipY }
    Patch "UTNHFTIL", 48, 48 { FlipX FlipY }
}
